'''Original Vampires''' sit at the top of the food chain — stronger, faster, and able to command a bloodline.


== How to Become One ==
The only way to become an Original Vampire is the '''Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) game pass''' — 1,895 Robux, or 1,706 with the Premium discount. Confirmed on the game's Discord: there is no leveling, aging, or bite route.


== Moveset (in-game) ==
* '''X''' — Heart Rip
* '''B''' — Sleep
* '''V''' — Break Neck
* '''E''' — Drink Blood
* '''C''' — Hypnotize
* '''R''' — Infect
* '''F''' — Track
* '''G''' — Bat Form — Lv 2000
* '''Ctrl+M1''' — Barrage
* '''H''' — Head Rip
* '''T''' — Pierce Organs
* '''Q''' — Bat Swarm — Lv 600


== Sunlight and Immortality ==
Sunlight still damages an Original Vampire, but it cannot kill one — Originals are immortal to sun damage. The only way to kill an Original Vampire is with a White Oak Stake.
Sun damage workarounds: a Sun Ring gamepass (695 Robux, or 626 with the Premium discount — grants sun immunity plus strength and speed bonuses and unlimited double XP, and no other powers), a witch-crafted sun ring, or a Vampire Hat bought at spawn for 400 in-game money.


== Powers (reported) ==
* Stronger physical abilities and faster movement than normal vampires
* Compulsion usable against normal vampires
* Commands a sire line: turned vampires share a bloodline bond with their progenitor Original


== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' Best stats in the game, bloodline command, Compulsion over lesser vampires, immortal to sun damage (sunlight hurts but can't kill)
* '''Weaknesses:''' White Oak Stake, high visibility — everyone wants the kill
